newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Monmouth County, N.J.

text.p: SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Director of Finance of the Board of Chosen Freeholders of the County of Monmouth, New Jersey (the
Records, Finance Department, Third Floor, Freehold, New Jersey, on
until 11:00 A.M. at which time they will be publicly opened and announced, for the purchase of the County's General Obligation Bonds, consisting of $33,000,000 General
Improvement Bonds and $7,300,000 County College Bonds
(County College Bond Act, P.L. 1971, C. 12), dated August 1, 1997 and due on August 1, as follows (collectively, the Bonds''):
maturing in the principal amount of $1,500,000 in the year
$7,300,000 County College Bonds, Series 1997 (County College Bond Act, P.L. 1971, C. 12), maturing in the principal amount of $730,000 in the years 1998 to 2007, inclusive.
The combined maturity schedule for the Bonds is as follows:
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount
Individual purchases of beneficial ownership interests in the Bonds will be made in book-entry form (without

certificates) in the denomination of $5,000 each or any integral multiple thereof. The Bonds will bear interest at a single rate of interest in a multiple of 1/8 or 1/20 of 1% per annum specified by the successful bidder payable on

February 1, 1998 and semiannually thereafter on August February 1 in each year until maturity. The Bonds maturing on or after August 1, 2007 are subject to redemption at the option of the County in accordance with the Notice of Sale dated July 30, 1997 (the Notice of Sale''). The Bonds will be awarded to the bidder on whose bid the total loan may be made at the lowest net interest cost in accordance with the terms of the Notice of Sale.

Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement, the Notice of Sale, the Proposal for Bonds and the form of the legal opinion of Crummy, Del Deo, Dolan, Griffinger & Vecchione, a Professional Corporation, Newark, New Jersey, bond counsel to the County, may be obtained from the Director of Finance of the County at the Hall of Records, Finance Department, Third Floor, Freehold, New Jersey 07728-1256 (telephone (908) 431-7391), or from the County's financial advisor, Public Resources Advisory Group, 40 Rector Street, New York, New York 10006 (telephone (212) 566-7800).
